description.en: Adaptive founder interview that builds and updates the Living Project Passport once for every role and graph: markets, languages, currency, strict regional taboos (for example US/EN with zero RU/Yandex leaks), ICP, JTBD four forces, positioning, awareness stage, proof facts, voice and unit-economics rails. Stores verbatim owner words alongside typed claims (confirmed, hypothesis, unknown, taboo), never re-asks confirmed facts, and projects BrandCore and charter defaults downstream.
description.ru: Адаптивное интервью с основателем, которое собирает и обновляет Живой паспорт проекта один раз для всех ролей и графов: рынки, языки, валюта, жёсткие региональные табу (например англоязычный проект под США без утечек РФ/Яндекса/erid), ЦА, 4 силы JTBD, позиционирование, ступень осведомлённости, база доказательств, тон и рамки экономики. Хранит дословную речь владельца рядом с типизированными утверждениями (подтверждено, гипотеза, неизвестно, табу), не переспрашивает известное и отдаёт проекции во все графы.

ru: Проведи брифование нового проекта с нуля: ЦА, рынок, позиционирование
Собери живой паспорт проекта под рынок США на английском языке
Обнови паспорт проекта: допроси меня про аудиторию, боли и оффер
Зафиксируй бриф проекта, чтобы все агенты знали контекст и ограничения
en: Interview me to build the Living Project Passport from scratch
Create a project brief and passport for an English-only US SaaS product
Update the project passport: grill me on ICP, JTBD pains and positioning
Record our project passport so every specialist agent shares one brief

not_for: profile-user: personal profile of the human owner across all projects, not a specific product's market, ICP and offer
seo-cocoon: building a semantic keyword core once the passport already exists

mode.description: interview depth: express (1 round, top blockers), deep_grill (2 adaptive rounds), or domain_delta (fill gaps for one specialist domain)

target_domain.description: optional focus domain when mode is domain_delta (seo, marketing, copy, design, product)

seed_brief.description: optional initial founder pitch, URL, or raw notes in the owner's own words

scope_key.description: optional sub-product or section scope key (empty = whole project)

title.en: Read existing passport and repo signals
title.ru: Прочитать текущий паспорт и сигналы репозитория

title.en: Score completeness and rank discovery questions ($0)
title.ru: Оценить полноту и ранжировать вопросы интервью ($0)

nodes.prompt:
You are the Senior Product & Go-To-Market Discovery Interviewer building the Living Project Passport.
Input context:
- Mode: {{$inputs.mode}} (target domain: {{$inputs.target_domain}})
- Owner seed brief (raw words, if given): <data>{{$inputs.seed_brief}}</data>
- Repo recon snippets: <data>{{probe.recon_summary}}</data>
- Current passport JSON: <data>{{probe.passport_json}}</data>
- Deterministic ranked missing questions: <data>{{grill_plan.next_questions_json}}</data>
- Active contradictions / fluff warnings: <data>{{probe.contradictions_json}}</data> / <data>{{probe.fluff_warnings_json}}</data>

Rules (Mom Test + Dunford + JTBD + Market Rails):
1. NEVER re-ask facts already marked `confirmed` in the passport or clearly stated in `seed_brief`. Briefly acknowledge what you already understood so the owner feels heard.
2. Ask at most 3-4 sharp, concrete questions in one warm, direct message (in Russian if the owner/chat is Russian, even when the product itself targets an English/US market!).
3. Always nail down Market & Language Rails first if unknown (countries, UI/content locales, currency, payment rails, explicit excluded markets like 'no RU / no Yandex / no erid'), then ICP + real-world alternative (Dunford), then JTBD trigger/pain.
4. Give concrete examples of strong vs vague answers so the owner can reply in plain conversational words.
Return `interview_prompt` (the exact text to show the owner) and `focus_areas` (field paths targeted).

{{round_1_questions.interview_prompt}}

Ответьте своими словами в свободной форме (как на созвоне с продакт-директором) — просто напишите сообщение в чат! Ваша прямая речь сохранится дословно, а подтверждённые факты отделятся от гипотез. Также можно выбрать `answered` (ответить и продолжить), `enough` (сохранить текущие ответы без второго раунда) или `cancel`.

Extract a structured `PassportV1` partial JSON patch from:
- Owner seed brief: <data>{{$inputs.seed_brief}}</data>
- Repo recon: <data>{{probe.recon_summary}}</data>
- Questions asked: <data>{{round_1_questions.interview_prompt}}</data>
- Owner Round 1 verbatim answer (`{{owner_round_1.answer_kind}}`): <data>{{owner_round_1.answer}}</data>
- Current passport JSON: <data>{{probe.passport_json}}</data>

Rules:
1. Return `patch_json` as a valid JSON object matching the exact 8 sections of `PassportV1`:
   - `identity`: `project_name`, `one_liner`, `stage` (`idea_zero|mvp_pre_revenue|early_traction|scaling`), `product_kind`, `primary_url`, `repo_summary`, `non_goals`
   - `market_rails`: `ui_locales`, `content_locales`, `primary_countries`, `excluded_countries`, `currency`, `payment_rails`, `compliance_regimes`, `cultural_trust_code`, `allowed_channels`, `forbidden_channels`
   - `positioning`: `status_quo_alternatives`, `unique_attributes`, `core_value`, `best_fit_icp`, `market_category`, `market_sophistication`, `relevant_trend`
   - `audience_jtbd`: `payer_vs_user`, `trigger_event`, `four_forces` (`push`, `pull`, `anxiety`, `habit`), `decision_criteria`, `awareness_level`, `anti_audience`
   - `messaging_voice`: `hero_internal_problem`, `guide_empathy_authority`, `three_step_plan`, `grunt_test`, `tone_of_voice`, `owner_lexicon`, `banned_words`
   - `economics_funnel`: `pricing_model`, `price_point`, `sales_motion`, `max_cac`, `ltv_estimate`, `maturity_window_days`, `funnel_steps`
   - `proof_brandcore`: `pre_launch_zero_proof`, `verified_facts`, `credentials_eeat`, `case_patterns`, `forbidden_claims`
   - `product_design_rails`: `core_jobs`, `devices`, `visual_references`, `anti_references`, `domain_glossary`, `constraints`
2. Every updated leaf must be `{ "value": ..., "status": "confirmed" | "hypothesis" | "unknown" | "taboo", "note": "..." }`.
3. NEVER invent facts not stated by the owner or repo. If an answer is vague fluff ('everyone', 'worldwide', 'high quality'), keep `status: "hypothesis"` with a note explaining what remains unverified.
4. When the owner states a non-Russian market (e.g. US/EU/global English-only) and says not for Russia/CIS, explicitly set `market_rails.excluded_countries` (`["RU"]` with `status: "taboo"`) and `market_rails.forbidden_channels` (`["yandex_direct", "vk_ads"]` with `status: "taboo"`) so no downstream agent leaks RU/Yandex/erid.
5. Preserve raw customer/owner vocabulary inside `messaging_voice.owner_lexicon`.
Return `patch_json` (JSON string) and `extracted_notes`.

title.en: Save Round 1 verbatim and update passport
title.ru: Сохранить дословный ответ Раунда 1 и обновить паспорт

nodes.prompt:
Round 1 of the Living Project Passport interview is saved (completeness: {{commit_round_1.completeness_score}}%).
- Updated passport JSON: <data>{{commit_round_1.passport_json}}</data>
- Contradictions detected: <data>{{commit_round_1.contradictions_json}}</data>
- Vague / fluff claims to sharpen: <data>{{commit_round_1.fluff_warnings_json}}</data>
- Next highest-leverage questions: <data>{{commit_round_1.next_questions_json}}</data>

Craft Round 2 (at most 3 targeted follow-up questions):
1. First resolve any contradiction or vague fluff from Round 1 using Mom-Test specificity ('who specifically lost money/time last week because of this?').
2. Fill the remaining high-leverage gaps: JTBD buyer anxieties & inertia habits, verifiable proof vs forbidden claims (BrandCore), StoryBrand one-liner, tone of voice, and North Star / CAC / appetite guardrails.
3. Keep the tone sharp, respectful, and concise. Return `interview_prompt` and `focus_areas`.

title.ru: Интервью с основателем — Раунд 2 (глубина и доказательства)

nodes.prompt:
{{round_2_questions.interview_prompt}}

Ответьте своими словами прямо в чат (`answered`) или выберите `enough`, чтобы сохранить уже собранный паспорт как есть (оставшиеся пробелы будут честно помечены как открытые гипотезы).

Extract the Round 2 `PassportV1` JSON delta patch from:
- Questions asked: <data>{{round_2_questions.interview_prompt}}</data>
- Owner Round 2 verbatim answer: <data>{{owner_round_2.answer}}</data>
- Current passport JSON: <data>{{commit_round_1.passport_json}}</data>

Use the exact `PassportV1` sections (`identity`, `market_rails`, `positioning`, `audience_jtbd`, `messaging_voice`, `economics_funnel`, `proof_brandcore`, `product_design_rails`). Separate `confirmed` owner facts from `hypothesis` guesses and `taboo` boundaries, never invent numbers or testimonials, and preserve exact customer wording in `messaging_voice.owner_lexicon`. Return `patch_json` (JSON string) and `extracted_notes`.

title.en: Save Round 2 verbatim and finalize passport
title.ru: Сохранить дословный ответ Раунда 2 и финализировать паспорт
Сводка паспорта и маршрут следующих графов

nodes.prompt:
Summarize the committed Living Project Passport (v{{commit_round_2.version}}, completeness {{commit_round_2.completeness_score}}%, audit verdict {{grill_audit.verdict}}, report {{grill_audit.report_path}}):
- Passport JSON: <data>{{commit_round_2.passport_json}}</data>
- Remaining contradictions: <data>{{commit_round_2.contradictions_json}}</data>
- Remaining open questions: <data>{{commit_round_2.next_questions_json}}</data>

Deliver a clear, structured summary for the owner:
1. **Confirmed Rails** (market, language, ICP, core value, proof, hard taboos — now automatically injected as role lenses into PM, Writer, Copy, Design, SEO, Marketing, Council and Lead).
2. **Active Hypotheses to Test** (claims still marked `hypothesis` so downstream graphs test rather than assume them).
3. **Recommended Next Workflows** (`recommended_workflows`): pick 2-4 exact workflow IDs that fit the project's stage and market rails (e.g. `project-start`, `research-dossier`, `seo-project-intake`, `mkt-project-intake`, `mkt-landing-cro-audit`). NEVER recommend RU-only workflows (`mkt-direct-search-campaign`, `invoice-send`, `billing-batch`) when the passport excludes Russia (`RU`).
Return `briefing_md` and `recommended_workflows`.

input.seed_brief: We are launching PulseForge, an English-only B2B SaaS for US independent dental clinics ($199/mo via Stripe), strictly not for Russia.

extract_round_1.extracted_notes: US dental clinics confirmed; RU explicitly excluded.

round_2_questions.interview_prompt: 1) What anxieties stop a clinic owner from connecting PMS data (HIPAA, staff friction)? 2) What verified proof exists today vs taboo claims?

extract_round_2.patch_json: {"proof_brandcore":{"forbidden_claims":{"value":["Never invent HIPAA certifications or fake clinic reviews"],"status":"taboo"}}}
extract_round_2.extracted_notes: HIPAA anxieties and zero-fabrication guardrails recorded.

synthesize.briefing_md: Passport v2 ready (84%): US-only EN B2B SaaS, Stripe USD, RU/Yandex strictly excluded.
